Title: Corpus scriptorum ecclesiasticorum Latinorum, vol. XXXXI (Sect. V Pars III): Sancti Aureli Augustini De fide et symbolo, De fide et operibus, De agone christiano, De continentia, De bono coniugali, De sancta virginitate, De bono viduitatis, De adulterinis coniugiis lib. II, De mendacio, Contra mendacium, De opere monachorum, De divinatione daemonum, De cura pro mortuis gerenda, De patientia, ex recensione Iosephi Zycha
Creator: Augustine of Hippo (354-430); Joseph Zycha (Editor)
Publisher: Prague, Vienna, Leipzig: F. Tempsky, G. Freytag (for the Kaiserliche Akademie der Wissenschaften, Vienna), CSEL vol. 41
Publication Date: 1900 (title page: MDCCCC; the host's date field says 1866, which is a catalogue error)
Rights: Public Domain (pre-1930 publication); the item record's possible-copyright-status is NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT
Language: lat (with Latin apparatus criticus and Latin praefatio; sigla and manuscript folio numbers interleaved)
Source: archive.org item corpusscriptoru18wiengoog, full-text OCR file corpusscriptoru18wiengoog_djvu.txt, fetched directly from https://archive.org/download/corpusscriptoru18wiengoog/corpusscriptoru18wiengoog_djvu.txt by the library/source-research thread (Claude), 2026-09-29. Google scan of a Harvard College Library copy.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the library thread; the item's OCR text follows byte-for-byte unchanged after the '---' line (nothing stripped, normalized or corrected, including the scan's own library front matter and the host's digitization notices). Rights basis: the printed date on the title page (MDCCCC = 1900), not the host's date field or rights field; the host's possible-copyright-status tag NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT is supporting evidence only.
Content note: The whole CSEL 41 volume: Praefatio (pp. V-XXXXVI) and thirteen works with their printed apparatus. It is the scan that the csel-dev TEI files for De fide et operibus, De agone christiano, De bono coniugali, De sancta virginitate, De mendacio, Contra mendacium and De opere monachorum cite as their printed source, and it carries the printed apparatus and manuscript sigla for them; for those seven works the TEI files are the preferred base and this scan is the print check. For De fide et symbolo, De continentia, De bono viduitatis, De adulterinis coniugiis, De divinatione daemonum, De cura pro mortuis gerenda and De patientia this scan is the only Latin witness vendored.

Omnibus  codicibiis  enumeratis  reliquum  est,  ut  quae  co- 
gnatiouis  rationes  inter  eos  intercedant  cuiusque  fide  textus 
qui  dicitur  constituendus  sit  paucis  exponamus.  atque  iliud 
certo  cei*tius  affirmari  potest  omnes  libros  manu  scriptos  ex 
uno  exemplari  originem  ducere.  id  enim  non  solum  mira

lias,  quarum  una  libris  RMP  efficitur,  altera  codd.  FASTNOVi

Qui  libri  praeter  hos  quos  modo  descripsi  in  catalogis 
deprehenduntur  eorum  aliquot  ita  examinaui,  ut  insignibus 
quibusdam  locis  quantum  eorum  scripturae  cum  meis  aut 
consentirent  aut  discordarent  inuestigari  iusserim.  qui  omnes

I.  1.  Quibusdam  uidetur  indiscrete  omnes  admittendos  esse 
ad  lauacrum  regenerationis,  quae  est  in  Christo  lesu  domino 

5  nostro,  etiamsi  malam  turpemque  uitam  facinoribus  et  flagitiis

ueraturos  aperta  etiam  professione  declarauerint.  uerbi  gratia,

ab   ea  discedat  et  tunc  ueniat  ad  baptismum,  sed  etiam  cum

mittatur  et  baptizetur  nec  inpediatur  fieri  membrum  Christi,

tur,  quam  sit  hoc  malum,  iamque  baptizatus  de  mutandis

V. 

DE  BONO  CONIVGALI. 

I.  1.  Quoniam  unusquisque  homo  humani  generis  pars  est 
et  sociale  quiddam  est  humana  natura  magnumque  habet  et 

5  naturale  bonum,  uim  quoque  amicitiae,  ob  hoc  ex  uno  deus 
uoluit  omnes  homines  condere,  ut  in  sua  societate  non  sola 
similitudine  generis,  sed  etiam  cognationis  uinculo  tenerentur.
